notes.title: DLC Updated (Again!) To Include Kearney's "This Is A Funny Song"
notes.notes: Kearney, the musician behind 199X's OST, has released a new LP. It's a live album, recorded in the real-life Delilah, CA! Grabbing the DLC now gets you the OST, Getaway Driver Takes Five, and This Is A Funny Song. Enjoy!

notes.title: DLC Now Updated To Include Kearney's "Getaway Driver Takes Five"
notes.notes:
Hey there!

In the time since 199X was released, the musician behind its soundtrack, Kearney, put out a new album. "Getaway Driver Takes Five" is set in the same town as 199X, well before the events of the game. Grabbing the free soundtrack DLC now comes with a complimentary copy of the album!


--Evan

notes.title: DLC Fixed!
notes.notes:
The DLC soundtrack should now be freely available to download! As a means of apology, I'm also pleased to announce that the soundtrack will be FREE, forever and ever.

Enjoy!

notes.title: DLC Troubles
notes.notes:
Hello! And thank you for visiting this page.

It currently seems as if the DLC soundtrack is not working properly. I'm trying to figure out what's wrong. Until then, folks are encouraged to download the soundtrack for free at 199X's website: http://www.agamewithoutmechanics.com/

Thanks for your patience, and sorry for the trouble.


--Evan
